info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Healthcare Appointments Providers-v1-spec
info.description: The Healthcare Appointment Providers API enables users to retrieve a comprehensive list of healthcare providers available for appointment booking. This API serves as a vital resource for applications in the healthcare domain, allowing developers to integrate provider information into their systems seamlessly. Clients, such as patient management systems and telehealth platforms, can utilize this endpoint to enhance patient experience by presenting a curated list of available providers. The API supports efficient queries, ensuring that consumers can access up-to-date information on healthcare service offerings.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of appointment providers.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the available appointment providers from the system. It returns a list of providers that can be used for scheduling appointments, including their details and availability.
